تستنبطوا (form X)
# تَسْتَنْبِطُوا (tastanbiṭū) /tas.tan.bi.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْبَطَ (istanbaṭa)
# تُسْتَنْبَطُوا (tustanbaṭū) /tus.tan.ba.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْبَطَ (istanbaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
